query: CREATE FUNCTION trg_stock() RETURNS TRIGGER LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE products SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - NEW.quantity WHERE product_id = NEW.product_id; RETURN NEW; END; $$; CREATE TRIGGER items_stock AFTER INSERT ON order_items FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION trg_stock(); INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price) VALUES (40, 16, 3, 399000); UPDATE products SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - 3 WHERE sku = 'ACC-001'; SELECT stock_quantity FROM products WHERE sku = 'ACC-001';

CREATE FUNCTION monthly_revenue(p_year INT, p_month INT) RETURNS NUMERIC LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$ SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount))), 0) FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('pending', 'cancelled') AND o.order_date >= make_date(p_year, p_month, 1) AND o.order_date < make_date(p_year, p_month, 1) + INTERVAL '1 month'; $$; SELECT monthly_revenue(2024, 1);
